just in case anybody hasn't seen it on the HMecology list already ....


From: hmec...@googlegroups.com [hmec...@googlegroups.com] on behalf of Schaub Michael [michael...@vogelwarte.ch]
Sent: 07 February 2020 09:05
To: hmec...@googlegroups.com
Subject: 3 modeling Post Doc positions in Switzerland

Good morning,

 

The Swiss Ornithological Institute is offering three postdoc positions in the areas of statistical modelling of bird abundance and distribution changes, ecological interactions and population dynamics.

One of them might be particularly interesting for the hmecology audience - it is about developing integrated population models for bird populations and will be supervised by Marc Kéry and me.

See the attachment for details on all of the offered positions.

Thank you for spreading.

 

Kind regards

 

Michael Schaub  

 

--
*** Three hierarchical modeling email lists ***
(1) unmarked: for questions specific to the R package unmarked
(2) SCR: for design and Bayesian or non-bayesian analysis of spatial capture-recapture
(3) HMecology (this list): for everything else, especially material covered in the books by Royle & Dorazio (2008), Kéry & Schaub (2012), Kéry & Royle (2016, 2020)
